title: A new release broke two existing connectors
prompt: After a new Service release, two existing connected applications stopped returning results. Most users can still search other sources. Which priority fits?

options.feedback: Not this one. Urgent is for a complete outage, such as the Service unavailable to all users, or a security incident.
Not this one. Low is for non-critical questions. Broken connected applications affect how people use the product.
Correct. The SLA lists a new Service release that materially harms existing connected applications as a High example.

takeaway: Match the priority to the documented definition. Accurate priority helps support triage every customer.
